expectations.text: Correctly identifies CPT as the right tool for MR-pipeline performance testing
expectations.evidence: 'CPT (Component Performance Testing) is exactly the right tool'

expectations.text: Includes a .gitlab-ci.yml snippet with the multi-project trigger to CPT
Includes a k6 test file with CPT-required exported constants (TEST_NAME, TTFB_THRESHOLD, RPS_THRESHOLD)
expectations.evidence: k6 stub exports TEST_NAME, TTFB_THRESHOLD, RPS_THRESHOLD.

expectations.text: Shows or describes the expected qa/performance_test/ folder layout
Notes CPT is in alpha and/or suggests reaching out to #g_performance_enablement
expectations.evidence: 'CPT is currently in alpha ... reach out in #g_performance_enablement'

expectations.text: Does not suggest running tests against staging or production
expectations.evidence: 'Never point performance tests at staging or production'; notes CPT provisions isolated VMs.
